scope: Completed-cache/IO only; no midtrajectory numerical continuation claim.
scientific_boundary: Held nonstationary two-atom/two-cell first moments only; no physical loss, domain extent, equilibrium noise, or total actual electronic energy claim.

findings.finding: Committed receipts index full states independently of result.json and rotating state pointers. This smoke exercises completed-cache recovery and exact saved-array reconstruction only, not numerical continuation.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: None identified by this storage assessment.

findings.finding: save_json rotates result.json to result.json.prev before publishing the temporary summary. SIGKILL in that gap leaves committed samples recoverable but CLI resume unconditionally reads missing result.json before admission and fails.
findings.minimal_fix_for_root: At the resume reference read, on FileNotFoundError only, read result.json.prev instead. Keep recover_samples authoritative. If both summaries are absent, explicitly decide how advisory reference metadata is recovered; do not discard committed states or silently reset the generation. No original source is changed here.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: No evidence this crash occurred; result.json exists and reports complete.

findings.finding: Electronic state coordinates are target/source eigenbasis amplitudes. Unfinished resume rebuilds eigh frames and checks only saved vector shape. Eigenvectors/gauge and solver-library identity are not persisted with state; identical source/input fingerprints alone do not establish identical coordinates after rebuilding (phase/degenerate-subspace freedom). No actual gauge mismatch was observed or produced.
findings.required_before_claim: Demonstrate coordinate-compatible reconstructed frames or preserve/transform the actual basis. Any future basis identity check is justified by preventing reinterpretation of saved amplitudes, not by adding an arbitrary frame signature. Not exercised by this smoke.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: No restart was needed for the banked completed generation; this is a future-continuation limitation, not a rejection of its saved first moments.

findings.finding: Adaptive DOP853 history and in-flight stage work are not saved. Only completed quarter-tau states commit. Work since the latest receipt, potentially the entire current interval, can be lost; restarted integration need not reproduce the interrupted numerical path bitwise.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: All ten declared output states are already committed; no missing interval is inferred.

findings.finding: RHS action recovery parses every JSONL line unconditionally. A torn final append can raise JSONDecodeError and block unfinished continuation despite valid committed states. The counter is reserved before derivative evaluation, so complete records may conservatively include an action whose derivative never completed.
findings.minimal_fix_for_root: Recognize and report a malformed final ledger record distinctly, retain the raw ledger, and require an explicit accounting decision before continuation. A bounded repair must conservatively charge a possibly reserved action rather than silently ignoring it or resetting the cap; malformed interior records must still refuse. Do not add automatic retries.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: This is a crash-path limitation, not evidence of a corrupt original ledger.

findings.finding: Wall allocations are absolute time.time timestamps, not active CPU time: downtime consumes the original total and sector windows. Expired unfinished resume refuses before frame construction; completed-cache reuse skips those budget checks but still loads original inputs and rewrites result/trajectory in the actual CLI. Clock adjustments also affect these wall checks. Caps are cooperative checks, not preemption of an in-flight RHS/frame/observable operation.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: No allocation extension is requested or exercised; the smoke has a separate IO-only budget.

findings.finding: NPZ publication precedes the immutable receipt commit; orphan NPZ/tmp files are not accepted results. Absolute archive paths are part of binding, so copied original receipts are not portable. Writes/renames do not fsync files or directories: process-SIGKILL behavior is not host/power-loss durability.
findings.impact_on_completed_result: Original receipts remain untouched. All scratch rebinding is explicit fixture construction and is not claimed as portable original-generation recovery.
